steps.say: I’m Titus, welcome to my site. I’ve built an agent into it, and the whole website is a tool I can use. Let me show you around.

Ask me about my work any time. If you’re hiring, click “I'm hiring — check my fit for a role” and paste the job description; I’ll tell you honestly how I fit. That button stays in Ask Titus after the tour.
I’m a Lead AI Engineer at Mastercard.
Each pass is one role; pick one up and it opens below. I’m picking up UOB and Illumina here, or you can see every role at once.
To find out more about my education, go here. I have a Master of IT in Business (AI track) from Singapore Management University.
My projects play like films. This one is fictional-bassoon, which I built on my own.
My writing is a newspaper of articles by year and theme, and you can ask me about any of them. Here are two examples you’ll also find in Ask Titus after the tour.
ask: How would you design production-ready agents?
LoRA, RAFT or GRPO: which fine-tuning approach should I use, and when?

steps.say: About is a periodic table of every tool I’ve used, lighting up in the order I picked each one up.
Want to learn more about me, the copilot? Click here. The colophon shows how I’m built and tested.

This was a recorded run. Now ask me anything and watch me drive the site live; type or tap the mic to ask out loud, and I’ll answer out loud. “I'm hiring — check my fit for a role” is right below whenever you need it.
